desc: Parse p into parts A, B, C by splitting on the two '*'; note which parts are empty.
Design occurrence finder (KMP) returning all start indices; empty pattern → list(range(n+1)) to unify cases.

Case analysis: non-empty B — per B occurrence j, bisect for largest A-start i with i+len(A) ≤ j and smallest C-start k ≥ j+len(B); candidate = k+len(C)-i. Empty B — per A-start i, first C-start k ≥ i+len(A).
Confirm empty-pattern conventions handle empty A/C/B naturally, including p="**" → 0 and "*C*" style cases.
Implement the solution code in the starter class with KMP + bisect, O((n+m) log n).
Verify against all four examples plus edge cases: p="**", empty A or C, overlap trap (s="aa", p="a*a*a" → -1), no-match cases; check empty-B branch break logic and empty-pattern occurrence lists.
Finalize code within delimiters, confirm constraints (1e5) are met.
